nodes.name: Daily Trigger 09:19 UTC
nodes.notes: Stage 1 — Trigger. Offset from the sentiment scrape (09:07) and YouTube pull (09:13).

nodes.name: Fetch Destinations
nodes.notes: Stage 2 — Destination inventory. Answers factually which platforms council streams actually reach, which settles the LinkedIn scope question.

nodes.name: Fetch Event History
nodes.notes: Stage 2 cont. Past events with titles and times.

nodes.name: Select Recent Events
nodes.notes: Stages 3 & 4. Emits a _noop marker rather than failing when there is nothing to ingest.

nodes.name: Has Events?
nodes.notes: Quiet-week short circuit. No events is a normal outcome, not a failure.

nodes.name: Fetch Chat History
nodes.notes: Stage 2 cont. The high-value call: community questions asked during a governance event, aggregated across every destination.

nodes.name: Fetch Viewer Analytics
nodes.notes: Stage 2 cont. Point-in-time live viewership per event. NOT comparable to YouTube lifetime view counts - do not sum them.

nodes.name: Normalize + Validate
nodes.notes: Stages 5 & 6. Records how many messages came in vs were kept, so a silent drop is impossible.

nodes.name: Commit to GitHub
nodes.notes: Stages 7 & 10. Deterministic path per event makes re-runs idempotent.

_notes.purpose: Council streams fan out across YouTube, X and Discord. Restream aggregates chat from all of them, so this is the community asking governance questions at the moment of governance - the highest-signal input available to the questions[] ledger.
_notes.credentials: Restream OAuth2 (create an app at developers.restream.io, set the n8n callback as redirect URI) and the existing repo-scoped GitHub API credential. Both are placeholders; reconnect after import.
VERIFY_BEFORE_ACTIVATING: API base URL - endpoints are documented as paths; https://api.restream.io/v2 is assumed and must be confirmed against developers.restream.io.
Response field names - items/messages/timestamp shapes are defensive guesses. Run once with the Commit node disabled and inspect the real payload before trusting the mapping.
Whether API access requires a paid Restream tier.
Chat history retention window - this determines whether backfill is possible and how quickly a stream must be ingested.
_notes.boundaries: Restream viewer counts are point-in-time for a live event. YouTube Data API stays authoritative for lifetime per-video statistics. Never sum the two.
_notes.owner: YouTube Analyst owns stream content intelligence; Automation Governance Architect owns this workflow's standard.
